symbols_adjustments.rationale: dpkg-gensymbols exposed std::piecewise_construct under the Resolute toolchain; keep this implementation/template export optional and use the upstream version floor without a Debian revision.

provider_adaptation.upstream_basis: KContacts v6.30.0 requires KF6 I18n, Config and Codecs; KDE upstream source/CMake has no KCoreAddons dependency.
KF6DocTools is optional in KDE KPackage v6.30.0. With that optional integration disabled, Debian-reference manpage install entries generated only by KDocTools must also be removed.

test_environment_adaptation.upstream_tool_basis: AppStream v1.1.2 documents AS_VALIDATE_NONET as equivalent to --no-net when validating metadata.
test_environment_adaptation.validation_effect: Disable remote URL reachability checks while keeping AppStream metadata validation and KDE upstream CTest enabled.

upstream_contract.cmake_basis: KDeclarative exports KF6::CalendarEvents; there is no KF6::Declarative library target.

binary_package_splits.description_short: KDE Declarative private Quick Controls runtime library
binary_package_splits.description_long: Private runtime library used by the KDE Quick Controls QML module. SupraLINUX preserves the Ubuntu binary-package contract while using KDE Frameworks 6.30 upstream.

provider_adaptation.upstream_basis: KDE KDeclarative v6.30.0 still builds and installs kquickcontrolsprivate with SOVERSION 0.
provider_adaptation.compatibility_basis: Ubuntu 26.04 publishes libkquickcontrolsprivate0 and qml6-module-org-kde-kquickcontrols depends on it.

upstream_contract.reason: KDocTools is optional upstream and remains disabled until a matching SupraLINUX provider is available.

provider_adaptation.upstream_basis: KService v6.30.0 finds KF6DocTools optionally and only adds docs/manpages when KF6DocTools_FOUND.

toolchain_symbol_adaptation.rationale: The symbol is emitted by the Resolute C++ toolchain but absent from the Debian 6.30 baseline. It is implementation/toolchain dependent and must not acquire a SupraLINUX Debian-revision minimum version.

GCC 15 on Ubuntu Resolute does not emit two std::shared_ptr template-instantiation RTTI/vtable symbols that Debian marks only arch-dependent, while it emits std::piecewise_construct. These are compiler/template implementation details, not KDE API loss.
selected_changes: retag two std::shared_ptr symbols as optional=templinst while preserving arch=!riscv64
add std::piecewise_construct as optional=toolchain at upstream version 6.30.0
